verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only generic standards-based authentication: phishing-resistant MFA for online accounts and services, plus FIDO2/WebAuthn passkey and PIV smartcard support. Those are the mechanisms identity providers rely on, but no item names Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace, and none describes admin policy enforcement. missing for 10: any documented integration with Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace; evidence of enforcing hardware-key-only authentication policies; admin setup guides; independent or hands-on corroboration of IdP deployments.
